meta.title: PassDrop - Temporary Archive Passwords
meta.description: A minimal, fast service for generating and retrieving temporary passwords for encrypted archives
header.subtitle: Temporary archive password generation & delivery
copy.failed: Copy failed. Please select the text and copy it manually.
fetch.title: Retrieve Archive Password
fetch.desc: Enter the filename the sender gave you to get the password (no need to include extensions like .zip / .7z).
fetch.hint: Extensions such as .zip / .rar / .7z are stripped automatically before matching.
fetch.warning: ⚠️ The password is permanently destroyed once the retrievals run out or the countdown reaches zero. Keep it somewhere safe!
fetch.errorDefault: The password does not exist or is no longer valid.
fetch.failed: Retrieval failed. The password may not exist or may have expired.
gen.title: Generate / Overwrite Password
gen.desc: Generate a temporary password for an archive you are about to send. If the filename already exists, you will be asked to confirm before the old record is deleted.
gen.customLabel: Custom password (leave blank to auto-generate a strong one)
gen.shareLabel: Direct link (the recipient opens it to retrieve the password):
info.dual.title: 🕒 Dual Expiry
info.dual.desc: The password is voided and destroyed as soon as either the time limit (default {hours}h) or the retrieval limit (default {views}) runs out.
info.guard.title: 🛡️ Overwrite Protection
info.guard.desc: Regenerating a password for an existing filename asks for confirmation, so old records are never overwritten by accident.
info.easy.title: 🚀 No Sign-up Needed
info.easy.desc: No accounts to create. Generate a direct link in one click, and recipients just open it to get the password.
modal.title: ⚠️ An active record already exists
modal.subtitle: A password for this filename is still active. Regenerating will delete the old password.
modal.dangerBody: Once you confirm, the old record and its password are permanently deleted right away. If you have already sent an archive encrypted with the old password, the recipient will no longer be able to retrieve that password to decrypt it!
confirm.delete: Permanently delete the password record for "{name}" now? Others will no longer be able to retrieve the password.
toast.overwritten: Old record deleted. New password generated.
error.network: Network request failed. Please check your connection or the server status.
error.requestFailed: Request failed. Please try again later.
error.NOT_FOUND: No password record found for this filename.
error.EXHAUSTED: This password has reached its retrieval limit and is no longer available.
error.REVOKED: This password is no longer valid or has been destroyed.
error.EXISTS: An active password already exists for this filename.
error.CLEAR_NOT_FOUND: No record found for this filename; nothing to delete.
api.cleared: The password record for "{name}" has been permanently deleted
